method: Current national CH*IWB owner scope + exact direct tariff evidence + official IWB Allmend Basel-Stadt tariff for exact Basel public residuals + restricted/no-auth classification
policy: Official Basel-Stadt tariff is applied only to current IWB EVSEs in Basel or the exact Rüchligweg 121 Riehen public-IWB site, where power/type fits a published tariff band. No extrapolation to Basel-Landschaft municipalities.
